title: Three signals to understand the GPU market.
summary: Start with the hardware, the price of access, and the evidence of demand. A foundation brief for your first visit, rather than a live market update.

stories.title: A GPU model is only the beginning.
stories.summary: NVIDIA documents distinct H100 configurations. Memory, form factor, interconnect, and server configuration belong alongside the model name when comparing hardware.
stories.whyItMatters: Valar perspective: a headline hardware price needs a comparable configuration and condition before it becomes useful evidence.
stories.watch: Follow H100 and ask which configuration, condition, and date each observation describes.

stories.title: Renting compute and owning hardware are different markets.
stories.summary: AWS offers GPU instances built around H100 and H200 hardware. A cloud instance also includes a specified CPU, memory, storage, and networking configuration.
stories.whyItMatters: Valar perspective: a rental quote is a price for access to a service. It cannot establish a hardware resale price or an investment return.
stories.watch: Compare the same GPU, region, commitment, and service bundle when following rental prices.

stories.title: Follow the evidence behind the AI buildout.
stories.summary: SEC EDGAR provides public company filings, including periodic reports and financial disclosures. It is a starting point for checking a company's own claims.
stories.whyItMatters: Valar perspective: separate spending plans from contracted hardware, deliveries, and operating capacity. An announcement alone does not establish revenue or utilization.
stories.watch: Read spending commitments beside revenue, cash flow, debt, and the assumptions management discloses.

signal.title: When does the music stop? Follow the pressure, not a prediction.
signal.summary: Our research framework watches rental pricing, hardware resale evidence, new capacity, durable demand, and operator finances together. It is a set of questions to investigate, not a live risk score or a forecast of an AI downturn.
signal.sourceLabel: Valar research framework · read the underlying disclosures
